'''2000 Ryloth Regionals''' was the Star Wars CCG regional championship for the Ryloth region (Netherlands) in the 2000 Decipher championship circuit.<ref name="dc00fin">[http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html DecipherCon 2000: Star Wars CCG Qualifiers], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010308110320/http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="rl00ryloth">[http://christo.decipher.com/regionals/swlist.html?game=sw&region=ryloth 2000 Regionals: Ryloth], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010727140605/http://christo.decipher.com/regionals/swlist.html?game=sw&region=ryloth Internet Archive]</ref>

[[Koen Meijssen]] of Utrecht, Netherlands won and qualified for the [[2000 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dc00fin" />

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Regional championship
* '''Date:''' 6 August 2000
* '''Site:''' De werft Huygenstraat 73 Kaatsheuvel, Noord-Brabant Netherlands
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Bas Van Zuilen]]
